# Sixth Street product principles

This is the compact producer for settled product judgment that otherwise has to
be reconstructed from scattered reviews, specs, instructions, and history. It
does not choose the next feature or settle a new consequential taste decision.

## Settled

### decision-first

Solve a concrete recurring Zenless Zone Zero player decision faster and more clearly than a generic encyclopedia page.

Evidence: AI Project Runway: Sixthstreet Prep!A2:H4; /home/alvin/imagination/apps/sixthstreet-wiki/README.md

### hierarchy-follows-player-job

Lead with the decision-bearing matchup, operation, or next action; provenance and raw detail support that decision instead of dominating it.

Evidence: AI Project Runway: Sixthstreet Prep!A3:H4; GPT Pro DA product review recorded in Sixthstreet Prep

### evidence-strength

Preserve source strength, provenance, freshness, cohort, and uncertainty; fail closed instead of converting observation into recommendation or unsupported mechanics.

Evidence: Sixth-Street-collaboration-contract-current.md; AI Project Runway: Bagel Spec!A8:H20; /home/alvin/imagination/vault/projects/sixthstreet-wiki/voice-brief.md

### actual-zzz-language

Use actual ZZZ and New Eridu vocabulary plus plain player actions; let utility and a coherent visual system carry the worldbuilding.

Evidence: /home/alvin/imagination/vault/projects/sixthstreet-wiki/voice-brief.md; AGENTS.md

### mobile-parity

A player can complete the same core decision at 360px; only secondary detail may progressively disclose.

Evidence: AGENTS.md; AI Project Runway: Bagel Spec!A19:H19; /home/alvin/imagination/apps/sixthstreet-wiki/AGENTS.md

### coherent-physical-system

Use a dense, tactile, non-SaaS information system whose color and hierarchy encode stable meaning; mode differences reflect actual rules rather than decoration.

Evidence: AI Project Runway: Sixthstreet Prep information architecture and DA review rows; /home/alvin/imagination/vault/projects/sixthstreet-wiki/voice-brief.md

### prove-wedge-before-platform

Prove one bounded decision job before adding account import, OCR, generalized planning, or persistent-profile infrastructure.

Evidence: AI Project Runway: Sixthstreet Prep first wedge and import/OCR rows; AI Project Runway: Bagel Spec!A20:H20

## Provisional or local

- An operations-briefing metaphor may fit a particular accepted surface, but it is not a universal Sixth Street product law.
- Random Play may be a visual or memory anchor without becoming the literal narrator of every product surface.
- Exact hero compositions, headlines, labels, and palette choices remain local product decisions unless separately converged.

## Rejected calibration

- Generic cyberpunk, SaaS-dashboard, glassmorphism, or empty marketing-page treatments.
- Invented game-like verbs or mechanics used only for flavor, including describing Deadly Assault or Shiyu Defense as queueing.
- Usage or observed-clear data presented as a recommendation without evidence that supports recommendation authority.
